```{r hill_loop, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

hill_info <- tibble(
  q = c("0", "1", "2"),
  hill_col = c("env_hill_qhill_q0", "env_hill_qhill_q1", "env_hill_qhill_q2"),
  group_col = c("env_div_group0", "env_div_group1", "env_div_group2"),
  outname = c("q0", "q1", "q2")
)

filtered_inputs <- pmap(
  hill_info,
  function(q, hill_col, group_col, outname) {
    tmp_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
      mutate(
        !!group_col := cut_number(.data[[hill_col]], n = 3, labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High"))
      )
    tmp_metadata_div <- tmp_metadata %>%
      filter(.data[[group_col]] %in% c("Low", "High"))
    samples_to_keep <- tmp_metadata_div$sample
    tmp_genome_counts <- genome_counts_filt %>%
      select(one_of(c("genome", samples_to_keep))) %>%
      filter(rowSums(select(., -genome) != 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
      select_if(~!all(. == 0))
    list(
      q = q,
      group_col = group_col,
      metadata_div = tmp_metadata_div,
      genome_counts = tmp_genome_counts
    )
  }
)
names(filtered_inputs) <- hill_info$outname
```
## Structural zeros

```{r env_structuralzeros, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Structural Zeros
structural_zeros_list <- purrr::map(
  filtered_inputs,
  ~{
    tmp_metadata_div <- .x$metadata_div
    tmp_genome_counts <- .x$genome_counts
    group_col <- .x$group_col
    
    Low_samples <- tmp_metadata_div %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] == "Low") %>% pull(sample)
    High_samples <- tmp_metadata_div %>% filter(.data[[group_col]] == "High") %>% pull(sample)
    existing_samples <- colnames(tmp_genome_counts)
    Low_samples <- Low_samples[Low_samples %in% existing_samples]
    High_samples <- High_samples[High_samples %in% existing_samples]
    
    tmp_genome_counts %>% 
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        all_zeros_Low = all(c_across(any_of(Low_samples)) == 0),
        all_zeros_High = all(c_across(any_of(High_samples)) == 0),
        average_Low = mean(c_across(any_of(Low_samples)), na.rm = TRUE),
        average_High = mean(c_across(any_of(High_samples)), na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(all_zeros_Low | all_zeros_High) %>%
      mutate(
        present = case_when(
          all_zeros_Low & !all_zeros_High ~ "High",
          all_zeros_High & !all_zeros_Low ~ "Low",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        average = case_when(
          present == "High" ~ average_High,
          present == "Low" ~ average_Low,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      )
  }
)
```

## MAGs in different enviromental diversity levels and shared among enviromental diversity levels
```{r env_chart1, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# Define colors for the two groups
groupcolors <- c('#408892','#c04062')  # for Low, High

# Loop *over names(filtered_inputs)*, which will be c("q0","q1","q2")
for(qname in names(filtered_inputs)) {
  f <- filtered_inputs[[qname]]
  
  # Extract relevant objects
  group_col <- f$group_col                  # e.g. "env_div_group0"
  metadata_div <- f$metadata_div            # filtered metadata for Low & High
  genome_counts <- f$genome_counts          # counts table with only those samples
  
  # Generate presence/absence: genomes as rows, samples as columns
  genome_pa <- genome_counts %>%
    column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    `>`(0) %>%
    `*`(1)
  
  # Which samples are "Low", which are "High"?
  groupings <- metadata_div[[group_col]]
  
  # Create logical vectors for group assignment
  low_samples  <- metadata_div$sample[groupings == "Low"]
  high_samples <- metadata_div$sample[groupings == "High"]
  
  # Aggregate: 1 if present in any sample in the group, 0 otherwise
  Low  <- as.integer(rowSums(genome_pa[,low_samples, drop=FALSE])  > 0)
  High <- as.integer(rowSums(genome_pa[,high_samples, drop=FALSE]) > 0)
  
  table_upset_analysis <- data.frame(Low=Low, High=High)
  rownames(table_upset_analysis) <- rownames(genome_pa)
  
  # UpSet plot
  cat("Plotting UpSet for", qname, "\n")
  upset(
    table_upset_analysis,
    sets = c("Low", "High"),
    sets.bar.color = groupcolors,
    keep.order = TRUE,
    mb.ratio = c(0.55, 0.45),
    order.by = "freq",
    main.bar.color = "gray30",
    mainbar.y.label = paste("Genomes (", qname, ")", sep=""),
    sets.x.label = "Number of genomes"
  )
}
```

## Ancomb2
### Enrichment analysis between high and low enviormental diversity

```{r env_phyloseqobject, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# --- Prepare Phyloseq object for ANCOMBC2
  phyloseq_list <- map2(
  filtered_inputs,
  structural_zeros_list,
  ~{
    tmp_metadata_div <- .x$metadata_div
    tmp_genome_counts <- .x$genome_counts
    structural_zeros <- .y   # For this q, as calculated before

    # -- Make phyloseq sample_data
    phylo_samples <- tmp_metadata_div %>%
      column_to_rownames("sample") %>%
      sample_data()

    # -- Remove structural zeros
    phylo_genome <- tmp_genome_counts %>%
      filter(!genome %in% structural_zeros$genome) %>%
      column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
      mutate_all(~ replace(., . == 0, 1e-5)) %>%
      otu_table(taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

    # -- Make phyloseq tax_table
    phylo_taxonomy <- genome_metadata %>%
      filter(genome %in% rownames(phylo_genome)) %>%
      mutate(genome2=genome) %>%
      column_to_rownames("genome2") %>%
      dplyr::select(domain,phylum,class,order,family,genus,species,genome) %>%
      as.matrix() %>%
      tax_table()

    # -- Assemble phyloseq object
    phyloseq(phylo_genome, phylo_taxonomy, phylo_samples)
  }
)

names(phyloseq_list) <- names(filtered_inputs)
```

#### MAG level

```{r env_ancombc, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ancom_results <- imap(
  phyloseq_list,
  function(physeq, qname) {
    group_col <- filtered_inputs[[qname]]$group_col  # e.g., "env_div_group0"
    cat(paste0("Running ANCOMBC2 for ", qname, " with group_col: ", group_col, "\n"))

    tryCatch({
      ancombc2(
        data = physeq,
        assay_name = "counts",
        tax_level = NULL, 
        fix_formula = paste0("~", group_col),
        rand_formula = "~1",
        p_adj_method = "holm",
        pseudo_sens = TRUE,
        prv_cut = 0,
        lib_cut = 0,
        group = NULL,
        struc_zero = FALSE,
        neg_lb = FALSE,
        s0_perc = 0.05,
        alpha = 0.05,
        n_cl = 2,
        verbose = TRUE,
        global = FALSE,
        pairwise = FALSE,
        dunnet = FALSE,
        trend = FALSE,
        iter_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 20, verbose = FALSE),
        em_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 100),
        lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),
        mdfdr_control = list(fwer_ctrl_method = "holm", B = 100),
        trend_control = NULL
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste0("ANCOMBC2 failed for ", qname, ": ", e$message))
      NULL
    })
  }
)
```

```{r env_ancombc_visulasation, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

colors_alphabetic <- read_tsv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/earthhologenome/EHI_taxonomy_colour/main/ehi_phylum_colors.tsv") %>%
  mutate(phylum = str_replace(phylum, "[dpcofgs]__", "")) %>%
  select(phylum, colors) %>%
  unique() %>%
  arrange(phylum)

ancom_taxcolor_tables <- imap(
  ancom_results,
  function(ancom, qname) {
    if(is.null(ancom)) return(NULL)  # if analysis failed, skip

    # 1. Tax table for q
    taxonomy <- data.frame(tax_table(phyloseq_list[[qname]])) %>%
      rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
      mutate(across(c(order, phylum, family, genus, species), ~ str_replace(., "[dpcofgs]__", ""))) %>%
      mutate(across(c(family,genus,species), ~ na_if(., ""))) %>%
      mutate(family = coalesce(family, paste('Unclassified', order)),
             genus = coalesce(genus, if_else(grepl('^Unclassified', family), family, paste('Unclassified', family))),
             species = coalesce(species, if_else(grepl('^Unclassified', genus), genus, paste('Unclassified', genus))))

    da_cols <- grep("^lfc_|^p_", names(ancom$res), value = TRUE)
    da_table <- ancom$res$diff_abn
    if (is.null(da_table)) return(NULL) # Skip if DA table is missing


    
    # If your DA column is different, adjust the next lines accordingly!
    lfc_col <- names(da_table)[grepl("^lfc_", names(da_table))]
    p_col <- names(da_table)[grepl("^p_",   names(da_table))]
    
    # Use first match, assuming there is only one main contrast
    lfc_col <- lfc_col[1]
    p_col <- p_col[1]

    # 3. Merge significant features with taxonomy
    ancom_sig <- da_table %>%
      filter(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05) %>%
      # Change this threshold/cutoff as you wish!
      arrange(.data[[p_col]]) %>%
      left_join(taxonomy, by="taxon")

    # Color mapping for plotting
    tax_table <- as.data.frame(unique(ancom_sig$phylum))
    colnames(tax_table)[1] <- "phylum"
    tax_color <- merge(tax_table, colors_alphabetic, by = "phylum") %>%
      arrange(phylum) %>%
      select(colors) %>%
      pull()

    # Print results in the Rmd
    cat(paste0("\n### Top Significant Features for Hill q=", qname, "\n"))
    if(nrow(ancom_sig)>0) {
      print(knitr::kable(head(ancom_sig, 20)))
      if(nrow(ancom_sig)>20) cat("*showing top 20 of", nrow(ancom_sig),"*\n")
    } else {
      cat("No significant results for this q value.\n\n")
    }

    list(sig_table = ancom_sig, tax_color = tax_color)
  }
)
```

```{r env_ancombc_rand_plot_phy, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=8, fig.fullwidth=TRUE}

barplots_by_q <- imap(
  ancom_taxcolor_tables, # This is the output from the previous merge/taxonomy chunk
  function(tabcol, qname) {
    sig_tab <- tabcol$sig_table
    tax_color <- tabcol$tax_color
    if(is.null(sig_tab) || nrow(sig_tab) == 0) return(NULL)

    # Identify logFC column automatically
    lfc_col <- names(sig_tab)[grepl("^lfc_", names(sig_tab))]
    if(length(lfc_col) == 0) {
      warning("No logFC column found for q = ", qname)
      return(NULL)
    }
    lfc_col <- lfc_col[1]

    # Identify the genome/species/feature name column (could be "genome" or "taxon" or "species"; use what you prefer)
    feature_col <- if("genome" %in% names(sig_tab)) "genome" else "taxon"
    # Adjust Y label accordingly:
    y_axis_lab <- ifelse(feature_col == "genome", "Genome", "Taxon")

    ggplot(sig_tab, aes(
      x = .data[[lfc_col]],
      y = forcats::fct_reorder(.data[[feature_col]], .data[[lfc_col]]),
      fill = phylum)
      ) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = tax_color) +
      geom_vline(xintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
      theme(
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical"
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "log2FoldChange",
        y = y_axis_lab,
        fill = "Phylum",
        title = paste("Significant differential abundance for Hill q =", qname)
      )
  }
)
# Print the plots, one by one in the document
for(qname in names(barplots_by_q)) {
  cat(paste0("### Differential Abundance Barplot for Hill q = ", qname, "\n\n"))
  plot_obj <- barplots_by_q[[qname]]
  if(!is.null(plot_obj)) print(plot_obj)
  else cat("_No significant results to plot for this q value._\n\n")
}
```

```{r env_ancom_rand_volcano, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}

# Download color palette
phylum_colors_df <- read_tsv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/earthhologenome/EHI_taxonomy_colour/main/ehi_phylum_colors.tsv") %>%
  mutate(phylum = str_replace(phylum, "[dpcofgs]__", "")) %>%
  select(phylum, colors) %>%
  unique() %>%
  arrange(phylum)

volcano_plots_by_q <- imap(
  ancom_results,
  function(ancom, qname) {
    if(is.null(ancom)) return(NULL)
    # Extract table and figure out which columns are present
    tab <- ancom$res$diff_abn
    genome_col <- if("genome" %in% names(tab)) "genome" else if("taxon" %in% names(tab)) "taxon" else names(tab)[1]
    # Identify logFC and p columns automatically:
    lfc_col <- names(tab)[grepl("^lfc_", names(tab))]
    p_col   <- names(tab)[grepl("^p_", names(tab))]
    if(length(lfc_col) == 0 | length(p_col) == 0) {
      warning("Did not find LFC or p columns for ",qname)
      return(NULL)
    }
    lfc_col <- lfc_col[1]; p_col <- p_col[1]
    volcano_tab <- tab %>%
      na.omit() %>%
      rename(genome = !!genome_col) %>%
      # Merge with genome metadata for phylum color (adjust join column if needed!)
      left_join(genome_metadata, by = "genome") %>%
      mutate(phylum_sig = ifelse(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05, phylum, NA_character_))
    # Make palette for just the present phyla
    used_phyla <- volcano_tab %>% filter(!is.na(phylum_sig)) %>% pull(phylum_sig) %>% unique() %>% na.omit() %>% as.character()
    used_colors <- phylum_colors_df %>% filter(phylum %in% used_phyla) %>% pull(colors, name=phylum)
    # The plot
    ggplot(volcano_tab, aes(x = .data[[lfc_col]],
                            y = -log10(.data[[p_col]]),
                            color = phylum_sig)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, show.legend = TRUE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = used_colors, na.value = "grey70") +
      labs(
        color = "Significant phylum",
        x = "log2 Fold Change",
        y = "-log10(p-value)",
        title = paste("Volcano Plot: DA for Hill q =", qname)
      ) +
      theme_classic()
  }
)

for(qname in names(volcano_plots_by_q)) {
  cat(paste0("### Volcano Plot for Hill q = ", qname, "\n\n"))
  plot_obj <- volcano_plots_by_q[[qname]]
  if(!is.null(plot_obj)) print(plot_obj)
  else cat("_No significant results to plot for this q value._\n\n")
}
```

```{r env_ancom_rand1, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
colors_alphabetic <- read_tsv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/earthhologenome/EHI_taxonomy_colour/main/ehi_phylum_colors.tsv") %>%
  mutate(phylum = str_replace(phylum, "[dpcofgs]__", "")) %>%
  select(phylum, colors) %>%
  unique() %>%
  arrange(phylum)

ancom_struczero_tables <- imap(
  ancom_struczero_results,
  function(ancom, qname) {
    if(is.null(ancom)) return(NULL)
    taxonomy <- data.frame(tax_table(phyloseq_list[[qname]])) %>%
      rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
      mutate(across(c(order, phylum, family, genus, species), ~ str_replace(., "[dpcofgs]__", "")))

    # Identify LFC and P columns dynamically for your group variable (not hardcoding sexFemale)
    tab <- ancom$res$diff_abn
    lfc_col <- names(tab)[grepl("^lfc_", names(tab))]
    p_col <- names(tab)[grepl("^p_", names(tab))]
    lfc_col <- lfc_col[1]
    p_col <- p_col[1]

    # Merge and filter significant features
    ancom_tab <- tab %>%
      select(taxon, !!lfc_col, !!p_col) %>%
      filter(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(.data[[p_col]]) %>%
      merge(taxonomy, by = "taxon") %>%
      mutate_at(vars(phylum, species), ~ str_replace(., "[dpcofgs]__", "")) %>%
      arrange(.data[[lfc_col]])

    # Color mapping
    tax_table <- as.data.frame(unique(ancom_tab$phylum))
    colnames(tax_table)[1] <- "phylum"
    tax_color <- merge(tax_table, colors_alphabetic, by = "phylum") %>%
      arrange(phylum) %>%
      select(colors) %>%
      pull()

    # Print table for this q
    cat(paste0("\n### Top significant taxa with structural zeros (Hill q=", qname, ")\n"))
    if(nrow(ancom_tab)>0) {
      print(knitr::kable(head(ancom_tab, 20)))
      if(nrow(ancom_tab) > 20) cat("*showing top 20*\n")
    } else {
      cat("No significant results for this q value.\n\n")
    }

    list(sig_table = ancom_tab, tax_color = tax_color)
  }
)
```

```{r env_ancom_rand_volcano_mag, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

phylum_colors <- read_tsv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/earthhologenome/EHI_taxonomy_colour/main/ehi_phylum_colors.tsv") %>%
  mutate(phylum = str_replace(phylum, "[dpcofgs]__", "")) %>%
  right_join(genome_metadata, by = "phylum") %>%
  select(phylum, colors) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(phylum) %>%
  pull(colors, name = phylum)

volcano_struczero_by_q <- imap(
  ancom_struczero_tables,
  function(tabcol, qname) {
    sig_tab <- tabcol$sig_table
    if(is.null(sig_tab) || nrow(sig_tab) == 0) return(NULL)

    # Identify LFC and p columns
    lfc_col <- names(sig_tab)[grepl("^lfc_", names(sig_tab))]
    p_col   <- names(sig_tab)[grepl("^p_",   names(sig_tab))]
    if(length(lfc_col) == 0 || length(p_col) == 0) {
      warning("No LFC or p-value column found for q = ", qname)
      return(NULL)
    }
    lfc_col <- lfc_col[1]
    p_col <- p_col[1]

    # Feature column (should be genome or taxon)
    feature_col <- if("genome" %in% names(sig_tab)) "genome" else if("taxon" %in% names(sig_tab)) "taxon" else names(sig_tab)[1]

    volcano_tab <- sig_tab %>%
      rename(genome = !!feature_col) %>%
      left_join(genome_metadata, by = "genome") %>% # merge for additional annotation (phylum) if needed
      mutate(
        phylum_sig = ifelse(.data[[p_col]] < 0.05, as.character(phylum), NA_character_),
        lfc = .data[[lfc_col]],
        pval = .data[[p_col]]
      )

    return(volcano_tab)
  }
)
```


#### Phylum level

```{r env_ancom_phylum, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
# Run ANCOMBC2 at the phylum level for each q
ancom_phylum_results <- imap(
  phyloseq_list,
  function(physeq, qname) {
    group_col <- filtered_inputs[[qname]]$group_col   # e.g. "env_div_group0"
    cat("Running ANCOMBC2 phylum-level for", qname, "with group_col:", group_col, "\n")
    tryCatch({
      ancombc2(
        data = physeq,
        assay_name = "counts",
        tax_level = "phylum",                     
        fix_formula = paste0("~", group_col),     
        rand_formula = "~1",                      
        p_adj_method = "holm", 
        pseudo_sens = TRUE,
        prv_cut = 0, 
        lib_cut = 0, 
        group = NULL, 
        struc_zero = FALSE, 
        neg_lb = FALSE,
        s0_perc = 0.05,
        alpha = 0.05, 
        n_cl = 2, 
        verbose = TRUE,
        global = FALSE, 
        pairwise = FALSE, 
        dunnet = FALSE, 
        trend = FALSE,
        iter_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 20, verbose = FALSE),
        em_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 100),
        lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),
        mdfdr_control = list(fwer_ctrl_method = "holm", B = 100), 
        trend_control = NULL
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("ANCOMBC2 failed for", qname, ":", e$message))
      NULL
    })
  }
)
```

```{r env_ancom_rand_phylum, comment="", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Loop through and pull out significant phyla for each q
ancom_phylum_signif <- imap(
  ancom_phylum_results,
  function(res, qname) {
    if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
    group_col <- filtered_inputs[[qname]]$group_col  # e.g. "env_div_group0"
    lfc_col <- paste0("lfc_", group_col, "High")
    p_col   <- paste0("p_", group_col, "High")
    # Defensive: check if columns exist
    if (!all(c(lfc_col, p_col, "taxon") %in% colnames(res$res))) return(NULL)
    res$res %>%
      dplyr::select(taxon, !!lfc_col, !!p_col) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        lfc = !!lfc_col,
        p = !!p_col
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(p) & p < 0.05) %>%
      arrange(p)
  }
)
```
